title_zh: 选择兼具幽默与思考的读书会开篇

scenario.label_zh: 选择兼具幽默与思考的读书会开篇
scenario.goal_zh: 比较两篇已经读过的短文风格并选定幽默短文作为讨论开篇

context_zh: 两位读书会成员已经读过两篇虚构短文，正在决定先讨论哪一篇。
author: author-phase12-c

sentences.speaker: Gabe
sentences.text: That essay about queueing was terrific. I laughed, then realised I do half the things it criticises.

sentences.speaker: Sana
sentences.text: The writer has real wit. The joke about saving a place does more than just get a laugh.

sentences.speaker: Gabe
sentences.text: It was surprisingly thought-provoking for such a short piece.

sentences.speaker: Sana
sentences.text: The other essay is good too, but its opening is much more serious.

sentences.speaker: Gabe
sentences.text: Let's begin with the funny one. People can start with a favourite line and move into the questions it raises.

sentences.speaker: Sana
sentences.text: Yes. We can save the other piece for the second half.
